methodology.source: Published K-Dreams historical race-line prediction, archived Kenseimk pre-race competition scores and class, K-Dreams recorded start time, Kenseimk trifecta payout.
methodology.selection: Original 50 were selected per month and race-type before payout, plus S9 hashed one per month; no payoff selection.
methodology.model: 2026-11-16 current source code retrospectively executed against 2025-11 to 2026-08 pre-race source fields; NOT the original race-day model nor frozen prediction
methodology.payout: 3連単100円均等・全エンジン同じレース。
methodology.bias: Small stratified sample and historic incomplete source features; no 2025-2026 annual ROI inference or bet-selection rules.
methodology.reporting: Use common complete-case only, and trim1/5 for jackpot-dependence. No claim of forward profits.
